name: Twig in HTML strings
comment: Sub-grammars swallow Twig. The HTML grammar consumes an entire attribute value as one string, so `href="{{ path('x') }}"` loses its highlighting, and the JavaScript and CSS grammars do the same inside <script> and <style>. This injects the Twig constructs back into all three.
injectionSelector: L:text.html.twig string.quoted -comment, L:text.html.twig source.js -comment, L:text.html.twig source.css -comment
